incident.ordinary_explanation: Severe backlighting: the sun directly behind the subject at 1/4000 s and ISO 50 blows out the sky and drops the subject below the sensor's dynamic range, rendering him as a featureless black silhouette. The glass facade would not show a reflection of a person standing at the window because the interior is darker than the exterior sky, so no reflection is expected. The next three frames show the same man clearly, and badge B-0114 with a 09:52 check-in and IR gate skin reading of 33.5C identify him as a living attendee.
incident.summary: A guest reported that a man beside her appeared as a faceless black shape with no reflection in the hack floor west glass. EXIF and adjacent frames show ordinary severe backlighting at sunset (1/4000 s, ISO 50, sun directly behind subject) with the same man clearly visible in the next three frames, identified by badge B-0114, a 09:52 check-in and a 33.5C IR gate skin reading.
